acceptedOutputModes.description: A list of media types the client is prepared to accept for response parts. Agents SHOULD use this to tailor their output.

taskPushNotificationConfig.description: Configuration for the agent to send push notifications for task updates. Task id should be empty when sending this configuration in a `SendMessage` request.

historyLength.description: The maximum number of most recent messages from the task's history to retrieve in the response. An unset value means the client does not impose any limit. A value of zero is a request to not include any messages. The server MUST NOT return more messages than the provided value, but MAY apply a lower limit.

disabled.description: Optional. Whether the callback is disabled. Disabled callbacks are ignored by the agent.

description.description: Optional. Human-readable description of the callback.

pythonCode.description: Required. The python code to execute for the callback.

proactiveExecutionEnabled.description: Optional. If enabled, the callback will also be executed on intermediate model outputs. This setting only affects after model callback. **ENABLE WITH CAUTION**. Typically after model callback only needs to be executed after receiving all model responses. Enabling proactive execution may have negative implication on the execution cost and latency, and should only be enabled in rare situations.

turns.description: Required. The turns in the conversation.

inputTypes.description: Output only. The input types of the conversation.

startTime.description: Output only. Timestamp when the conversation was created.

turnCount.description: Output only. The number of turns in the conversation.

entryAgent.description: Output only. The agent that initially handles the conversation. If not specified, the conversation is handled by the root agent. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/agents/{agent}`

schemes.description: A map of security schemes to the required scopes.

LfA2aV1SecurityRequirement.description: Defines the security requirements for an agent.

createTime.description: Output only. The time when the change was made.

displayName.description: Output only. Display name of the change. It typically should be the display name of the resource that was changed.

newResource.description: Output only. The new resource after the change.

resourceType.description: Output only. The type of the resource that was changed.

name.description: Identifier. The unique identifier of the changelog. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/changelogs/{changelog}`

originalResource.description: Output only. The original resource before the change.

resource.description: Output only. The resource that was changed.

action.description: Output only. The action that was performed on the resource.

author.description: Output only. Email address of the change author.

dependentResources.description: Output only. The dependent resources that were changed.

sequenceNumber.description: Output only. The monotonically increasing sequence number of the changelog.

description.description: Output only. Description of the change. which typically captures the changed fields in the resource.

nextPageToken.description: A token that can be sent as ListAgentsRequest.page_token to retrieve the next page. Absence of this field indicates there are no subsequent pages.

Chunk.description: A chunk of content within a message.

transcript.description: Optional. Transcript associated with the audio.

defaultVariables.description: A struct represents default variables at the start of the conversation, keyed by variable names.

updatedVariables.description: A struct represents variables that were updated in the conversation, keyed by variable names.

name.description: Optional. The name of the tool that can be used by the Agent to decide whether to call this ConnectorTool.

connection.description: Required. The full resource name of the referenced Integration Connectors Connection. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/connections/{connection}`

authConfig.description: Optional. Configures how authentication is handled in Integration Connectors. By default, an admin authentication is passed in the Integration Connectors API requests. action.description: Required. Action for the tool to use.

description.description: Optional. The description of the tool that can be used by the Agent to decide whether to call this ConnectorTool.

oauthToken.description: Required. Oauth token parameter name to pass through. Must be in the format `$context.variables.`.

audioEncoding.description: Required. The encoding of the output audio data.

toolResponses.description: Optional. The list of tool execution results.

expireTime.description: The time at which the chat token expires.

chatToken.description: The session scoped token for chat widget to authenticate with Session APIs.

ToolResponse.description: The execution result of a specific tool from the client or the agent.

tool.description: Optional. The name of the tool to execute. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/tools/{tool}`

response.description: Required. The tool execution result in JSON object format. Use "output" key to specify tool response and "error" key to specify error details (if any). If "output" and "error" keys are not specified, then whole "response" is treated as tool execution result.

toolsetTool.description: Optional. The toolset tool that got executed.

parentToolCallId.description: Output only. The id of the tool call that caused this one, when it was issued by a sub-agent working on behalf of a parent call. Empty for top-level calls. Lets a client group a sub-agent's work under the call that started it instead of rendering every step as a sibling.

displayName.description: Output only. Display name of the tool.

id.description: Optional. The matching ID of the tool call the response is for.

agentName.description: Output only. Human-readable name of the agent that issued this call, e.g. "Contract Architect". Empty when the root agent issued it.

textChunk.description: Text Token (for streaming Gemini responses word-by-word).

artifactChunk.description: Generated-document artifact event (live preview deltas + final GCS pointer).

optionQuestionsChunk.description: Structured clarification options parsed out of the model turn. The console renders these as a selectable option list instead of raw text.

sequenceNumber.description: Optional. Monotonically increasing sequence number for this session turn.

handoff.description: Tells the client to silently reconnect with resume_from_sequence_number: the task serving this stream is going away and the turn will continue elsewhere. Not an error; the stream completes normally after this event.

confirmationRequest.description: A blocking confirmation the agent paused on. The agent resumes when the answer arrives on a later request's `confirmation_response`. Only sent to clients that declared the CONFIRMATION_CARDS capability on the request.

sessionCheckpoint.description: Session checkpoint/compaction recap event containing user intent and rolling summary.

thoughtChunk.description: Thought text chunk (agent's reasoning before generating response).

turnMetadata.description: Optional. Turn-level metadata and intent categorization.

resumeSnapshot.description: A compacted replay of an in-flight turn, sent as the first event of every attach or resume before any live event. The client replaces any locally rendered state for this turn with the snapshot's contents.

turnInProgress.description: Optional. Indicates whether the turn is still actively running in the background.

turnCompleted.description: The turn has ended. Sent as the last event of every turn, on the original stream and on every attached or resumed stream, so clients can end the turn on an explicit signal instead of inferring it from stream closure.

textPrompt.description: Optional. Defines the prompt used for the system instructions when interacting with the agent in chat conversations. If not set, default prompt will be used.

voicePrompt.description: Optional. Defines the prompt used for the system instructions when interacting with the agent in voice conversations. If not set, default prompt will be used.

GoogleSearchToolPromptConfig.description: Prompt settings used by the model when processing or summarizing the google search results.

goldenEvaluationMetricsThresholds.description: Optional. The golden evaluation metrics thresholds.

goldenHallucinationMetricBehavior.description: Optional. The hallucination metric behavior for golden evaluations.

toolIds.description: Optional. The tools IDs to filter the toolset.
